base64: Standard canonical padded Base64 of strict UTF8; dash represents empty. At most4096 decoded bytes; NUL/malformed/surrogate UTF8 rejected. Provider must encode plaintext deterministically.
target_guard: unique visible enabled focused editable non-password node with exact resource-id
application window active and focused; root/node window ids and requested display0 agree
ACTION_SET_TEXT advertised; nonempty node/window bounds intersect
expected prior effective text exactly matches (visible hint is empty draft)
immediately re-observe same underlying node and text before effect
action: Exactly one ACTION_SET_TEXT; if already exact, no action. Only readback can be polled, never another action.
receipt: set_verified or already_exact with exact requested UTF8 readback base64 and hashes. Unknown actual other text is never returned.

exit_codes.22: action attempted but receipt not verified/outcome unknown; do not retry
exit_codes.25: own test-service cleanup not confirmed; no effect retry

cleanup: finally disconnect own UiAutomation and shutdown own UiAutomationConnection object; quit own callback thread. No Android daemon shutdown.
no_persistent_modifications: No IME installation, selection or keyboard switch
No AccessibilityService settings changes; temporary own test service uses DONT_SUPPRESS_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES
No direct app-state-file writes, no message Send/Submit
No persistent helper replay store; outer R5 immutable identity/no-redispatch remains required

root_fixture_example.preparation: Root or model must focus the observed field by its actual UI before invoking. First use expected=- text=- to verify setup without changing field.
root_fixture_example.verification: For actual Chinese text, retain helper set_verified receipt plus separate actual App UI readback; pressing fixture Submit is a separate explicitly chosen UI action.

known_limits: Only observed default display0 qualified; caller must verify active physical display/rotation before dispatch. Nondefault is rejected, not redirected.
Hidden constructor/connect/teardown APIs must be qualified on actual stock A16 by Root; source presence and host build alone do not prove runtime reflection access.
Password, unfocused, custom drawn/noneditable, ambiguous or stale targets rejected.
Resource id is required; anonymous editable virtual nodes are not covered by this version.
r2_correction: Prepare missing main Looper before UiAutomation setup; actual Root R1 failure was a UiAutomation/AIC Handler NullPointerException before field access, not USB or radio. No new persistent settings.
